description: Hosted, read-only Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants live data from GONDI, an NFT marketplace with peer-to-peer lending: prices, bids, listings, sales, lending and borrowing. This repository holds its README, registry manifest and eval questions.
rules: The server is hosted at https://api.gondi.xyz/mcp over streamable HTTP: there is nothing to install or run.
It needs no authentication: no API key and no wallet. Requests are rate-limited per IP address.
It is read-only: no tool holds keys, signs or sends transactions. Users act with their own wallet on https://www.gondi.xyz.
Tools that take a slug get it from search_gondi rather than guessing it.
Chains are ethereum, hyperliquid and robinhood; currencies are WETH, USDC, WHYPE, HUSDC, RWETH and USDG.
The full GONDI documentation, including the MCP server page, is at https://docs.gondi.xyz.
